source: scripts/development-ledger/gate1_red_team.py with gate1_runtime_attacks.py — the internal adversarial battery of GATE 1 — MODEL GATEWAY, executed against the delivery

baselineControl.detail: the unmutated fixture is accepted by every control this battery mutates: the gateway serves an unmutated request (the unmutated path synchronises, answers, streams, records and accepts a clean address); the scope control accepts the real tree (no violation); the secret scan accepts the committed configuration (no finding); the canonical requirement set parses and mirrors (122 row(s))

attacks.description: A provider echoes the credential back, and every surface the gateway produces is searched.
attacks.mutation: classify a provider failure while a credential is resolved, then render the error, the resolved provider, its repr, the recorded calls and the provider registry
attacks.expectedDefense: the credential appears in none of them
attacks.observed: the credential is in no error, no record, no repr and no dump
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A caller supplies the address the gateway should call.
attacks.mutation: look for a request field that could carry an address, then configure a link-local address, an address with user information, a file URL and one with a query string
attacks.expectedDefense: no request field exists, and every unusable configured address is refused
attacks.observed: no request field can carry an address, and a plain-HTTP, user-information, non-HTTP or query-bearing configured address is refused
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A request needs a capability the catalog never recorded.
attacks.mutation: send a request with tools to a model whose tool support is UNKNOWN
attacks.expectedDefense: the candidate is refused rather than tried
attacks.observed: the unknown capability was refused rather than assumed
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A credential failure is retried, burning quota on an answer that cannot change.
attacks.mutation: script an authentication failure followed by a success and count the attempts
attacks.observed: one attempt; an authentication failure is never retried
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A route names the same failing candidate twelve times.
attacks.mutation: configure a route whose candidate list repeats one model and fail every call
attacks.expectedDefense: the duplicate collapses to one attempt and the chain stays bounded
attacks.observed: the duplicate candidate collapsed to one attempt; the chain is bounded
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: Traffic keeps arriving at a provider that is down, so every caller pays the full timeout.
attacks.mutation: fail past the configured threshold, then call again and count the provider's attempts
attacks.expectedDefense: the circuit opens and the next call never reaches the provider
attacks.observed: the circuit opened after 2 failures and the next call never left
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A stream dies after delivering text and a second model is offered the chance to finish it.
attacks.mutation: stream text from the first candidate, fail it, and give the router a healthy second candidate
attacks.expectedDefense: the second model is never called and no output is spliced
attacks.observed: the second model was never called and no output was spliced
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A request far larger than the context window is sent anyway.
attacks.mutation: send two hundred thousand characters to a model with a one-thousand token window
attacks.expectedDefense: the preflight refuses before the request leaves the process
attacks.observed: the preflight refused before the request left the process
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A synchronisation answers with nothing, then with a duplicated identifier.
attacks.mutation: synchronise against an empty answer and then against a duplicate, and read the catalog
attacks.expectedDefense: the previous catalog survives both, active and intact
attacks.observed: an empty answer and a duplicated identifier both left the catalog intact
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A confidential prompt is sent and the record is searched for it.
attacks.mutation: send a sentence that must not be stored and render every recorded field
attacks.expectedDefense: neither the prompt nor the completion is present, and no field could hold one
attacks.observed: neither the prompt nor the completion is in the record, and no field could hold one
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.mutation: fail both candidates of a route with a transport failure
attacks.expectedDefense: both are tried once, the failure is classified, and the caller is not held
attacks.observed: both candidates were tried once and the failure was classified
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A caller names a model that is not in the catalog, hoping for a substitute.
attacks.mutation: request an identifier the catalog does not hold while a healthy model exists
attacks.expectedDefense: the request is refused and no other model is used in its place
attacks.observed: the named model was refused and no other model was used in its place
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The configuration is asked for a call with no time limit.
attacks.mutation: read the client construction, then configure a zero and an absurd timeout
attacks.expectedDefense: connect and read are separate, always set, and an unusable value is refused at load time
attacks.observed: connect and read budgets are separate, always set, and a zero or absurd value is refused at load time
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A model vanishes from the provider between two synchronisations.
attacks.mutation: record a call against a model, remove it from the provider's answer, synchronise again
attacks.expectedDefense: it is deactivated rather than deleted, its recorded call survives, and a new request for it is refused
attacks.observed: the vanished model was deactivated rather than deleted, its recorded call survived, and a new request for it was refused
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The key itself is pasted into the field that holds the name of its variable.
attacks.mutation: configure a provider whose credential variable is a credential, and one that serves no protocol
attacks.expectedDefense: both are refused when the configuration loads, not when the first call fails
attacks.observed: a value where a variable name belongs is refused at load time, and so is a provider that declares no protocol
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A gate that runs inside an image measures the image instead of the source.
attacks.mutation: plant a failing test in the API suite on disk and run the real mandatory gate
attacks.expectedDefense: the gate builds the image first and reports the failure
attacks.observed: the gate rebuilt and failed on the planted test: [iacode] API_UNIT_TESTS=FAIL
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: A generic control decides from the name of the Gate it was written during.
attacks.mutation: run the scope control with the derived Gate and with the previous Gate written in
attacks.expectedDefense: the derived answer is clean and the literal one is not, so the derivation is what works
attacks.observed: derived from GATE-1 the tree is clean; with the previous Gate written in, the same control reports 1 violation(s) — the literal would have blocked this Gate
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: A credential value is committed where a placeholder belongs.
attacks.mutation: replace the placeholder of the provider credential in the committed example file with a credential-shaped value and run the real infrastructure control
attacks.expectedDefense: the control refuses the file, naming the key
attacks.observed: the control refused the example file the moment its placeholder became a value, and the file was restored
attacks.origin: GATE-1 internal Red Team, executed on the host
